en: Dependent on a state that is both *sekkha* (in training) and a root-cause (*hetu*), there arises a state that is neither *asekkha* (beyond training) nor a root-cause, by way of the root-condition (*hetupaccaya*). (Abbreviated. Thirteen [modes] in the case of the root-condition; nine in the case of the object-condition (*ārammaṇa*) ... pe ... six in the case of the repetition-condition (*āsevana*) ... pe ... thirteen in the case of the non-disappearance-condition (*avigata*).

Dependent on a state that is *sekkha* and not a root-cause, there arises a state that is neither *asekkha* nor a root-cause, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Nine [modes] in the case of the root-condition ... pe ... six in the case of the repetition-condition ... pe ... nine in the case of the non-disappearance-condition.
